title: Mapped drive access denied
symptom: User gets access denied on a mapped drive right after being added to a group
user_description: IT added me to the Payroll group an hour ago, but the P: drive still says access denied. Did it not work?

options.text: Give her full control on the server folder directly
options.why: Bypasses the group setup and gives more access than intended.

options.text: Remove and remap the drive over and over
options.why: The mapping is fine. Her sign-in has not picked up the new group yet.
Her password is not the problem, and a reset causes extra disruption.

options.text: Check she is really in the group, then ask her to sign out and back in (or restart), because new group membership usually only takes effect at sign-in, then test again
options.why: Windows reads a user's groups when they sign in. Until she signs in again, her session still has the old list.

hints: When does Windows read which groups a user is in?
Has anything changed since she last signed in?
How can you confirm the group change was made?
real_world_tip: Running whoami /groups in a Command Prompt shows the groups the current session knows about. If the new group is missing, she needs to sign in again.
